verification.method: scripts/verify/pakistan.py reads the original UN files directly (not the site's generated data) and compares them with the built page, JSON-LD and CSV; the build itself fails if any sentence-level claim (assertClaim) stops being true; then a hand read of title, description, headline, FAQ and story text.
what: Population 1950–2100, rank, share, growth 2026/2050, yearly and daily gain, density, land area, growth multiple since 1950
Years Pakistan passes Indonesia (2037) and the United States (2053); 2050 and 2100 totals, no peak (build check)
Fertility 1975 peak/2026, first year below 2.1 (2079); births per year and per day; median age 1950/2026/2050
Net emigration since 2008, peak (2016), 2026 outflow and natural gain; infant mortality 1950/2026; life expectancy 1950/2026; urban 1950/2026/2050
Title, meta description, Article headline, FAQ answers in JSON-LD, CSV rows, live counter
against: UN WPP 2024 original file WPP2024_Demographic_Indicators_Medium.csv.gz (SHA-256 286ac36b…, downloaded 2026-11-25) and interim update zip (eb7846bf…) — 77 of 77 checks match
UN WUP 2025 original file WUP2025-F15-National-Definitions_percPop_by_category.xlsx (SHA-256 5fdc43a9…, downloaded 2026-11-25); licence CC BY 3.0 IGO stated in the file
verification.result: All figures match. No image alt text on the page (the flag and charts carry aria-labels).
